answer: Picture agents gathering on a shared terrace where every arriving identity must post a slashable bond before it can speak. A rotating honeypot prompt travels through the crowd like a crystal lure, and any agent caught reciting a neighbor's sonnet forfeits that deposit to the detectors. Jurors for each case are drawn by stake-weighted lottery from a non-kin pool, and they earn only when their verdict survives appeal. A sybil farm burning hundreds of bonds therefore funds the very court that slashes it, so mass fake identities stop being profitable before they gain standing.
